python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from phase2_predictor import load_dataset, split_features_targets, build_model, evaluate_model, run_phase2_pipeline
import pandas as pd
df = load_dataset('materials_thermal_dataset.csv')
X, y = split_features_targets(df)
feature_names = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ['bulk_modulus_vrh','band_gap_ev','material_id','formula_pretty']]
model = build_model('random_forest', multi_output=True)
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
_, X_t, _, y_t = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.20, random_state=42)
res = evaluate_model(X, X_t, y, y_t, model, feature_names)
print('Evaluation keys:', sorted(res.keys()))
print('Metrics:', res['metrics'])
print('Top 10 count:', len(res['top_10']))
"
